title_en: Symmetry, Thermodynamics and Topology in Active Matter
title_zh: 活性物质中的对称性、热力学与拓扑

verified_metadata.title: Symmetry, Thermodynamics and Topology in Active Matter
verified_metadata.abstract: This article summarizes some of the open questions in the field of active matter that have emerged during Active20, a nine-week program held at the Kavli Institute for Theoretical Physics (KITP) in Spring 2020. The article does not provide a review of the field, but rather a personal view of the authors, informed by contributions of all participants, on new directions in active matter research. The topics highlighted include: the ubiquitous occurrence of spontaneous flows and active turbulence and the theoretical and experimental challenges associated with controlling and harnessing such flows; the role of motile topological defects in ordered states of active matter and their possible biological relevance; the emergence of non-reciprocal effective interactions and the role of chirality in active systems and their intriguing connections to non-Hermitian quantum mechanics; the progress towards a formulation of the thermodynamics of active systems thanks to the feedback between theory and experiments; the impact of the active matter framework on our understanding of the emergent mechanics of biological tissue. These seemingly diverse phenomena all stem from the defining property of active matter - assemblies of self-driven entities that individually break time-reversal symmetry and collectively organize in a rich variety of nonequilibrium states.

sections.title: 作者信息
bullets: 作者：Mark J. Bowick、Nikta Fakhri、M. Cristina Marchetti、Sriram Ramaswamy；UCSB、MIT、IISc。
官方快照：arXiv:2107.00724v3；23 页、10 图；发表于 Phys. Rev. X 12, 010501。
文章源于 2020 年 KITP Active20 九周项目；作者明确称其不是 field review，而是受参与者讨论影响的个人、选择性研究路线图。

sections.title: 摘要
bullets: 活性物质由单元逐个消耗自由能并持续、局域地破坏 time-reversal symmetry；这一区别把它与边界剪切或全局外力驱动的普通非平衡体系分开。
文章把 active turbulence、motile topological defects、flow control/assembly、nonreciprocity、chirality、nonequilibrium thermodynamics 与 tissue mechanics 串成开放问题网络。
统一线索不是一套闭合方程，而是 symmetry breaking、detailed-balance violation、energy/information flow 如何跨尺度产生 collective states。

sections.title: 背景
bullets: 历史线从 Reynolds/Aoki/Partridge 的 agent models 到 Vicsek 与 Toner–Tu；重点是 self-driven entities 的 collective order 需要超越 equilibrium phase-transition intuition。
active systems 可从细胞核到鸟群，synthetic realizations 包括 vibrated grains、Quincke rotors、phoretic colloids 与 cytoskeletal active nematics。
Active20 的议程关注未来连接而非教材式覆盖；因此任何“领域共识”都应回到被引原论文或更新综述核查。

sections.title: 模型与方法
bullets: Sections II–IV 以 polar/nematic hydrodynamics、spontaneous-flow instability、active length scale 与 defect quasiparticles 组织 active turbulence 和 flow control。
+1/2 nematic defect 因 comet-like texture 可 self-propel，−1/2 的三重对称令孤立 core velocity 消失；defect interaction、creation/annihilation 与 texture relaxation 共同决定 active defect gas。

Sections V–VII 从 self-phoretic assembly、nonreciprocal coupling 和 chirality 出发；不满足 action–reaction 的 effective interactions 可导致 traveling/oscillating states、odd elasticity 与 non-Hermitian/PT-like structures。
Section VIII 比较 FDT violation、thermodynamic uncertainty relations 与 trajectory time-reversal relative entropy；Eq. (7) 给 Qdot_diss≥kBT Ddotτ 的 coarse-observation lower bound。
Section IX 将 phase-field/Vertex/Voronoi 等 mesoscopic tissue models 与 molecular signaling、active stress、mechanics连接，目标是把 continuum coefficients 绑定到可控实验量。
全文主要综合已发表理论和实验并列开放问题，不进行 meta-analysis、统一仿真或新数据拟合。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
bullets: Figure 2 展示 ±1/2 defect texture/flow：activity 可使 +1/2 对抗 Coulomb attraction并 unbind，但完整 creation–annihilation rate 与 many-body orientation dynamics 仍未解决。
生物案例包括 epithelial extrusion/apoptosis、bacterial multilayering 和 Hydra morphogenesis；相关性与局部 stress evidence 有启发性，但文章反复把时间先后与因果机制列作待检验问题。
Figure 3 所引实验用 passive LC interface/磁场对 active nematic alignment；另一路以 geometry、curvature、optogenetic activity patterning 驯化流和引导 defects。
nonreciprocal binary/polar models 可产生 dynamical chiral phases、traveling patterns 或 arrested phase separation；这些是各引用模型的结果，不是所有 active mixtures 的必然行为。
Figure 7 的 starfish embryos 构成 living chiral crystals 并 collective rotate；hydrodynamic force/torque exchange 展现 chirality 与 nonreciprocity 的宏观后果。
Figure 8 的 irreversibility-versus-lag peak 用时间序列正反可辨识性定位 nonequilibrium timescale；Eq. (7) 只给耗散下界，有限观察变量可能漏掉 hidden entropy production。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
bullets: 这是 2020 讨论形成、2021 定稿的 biased selection；快速发展的 active matter 文献和后来实验可能改变当时的 open-question 状态。
active turbulence 与 high-Reynolds-number turbulence 的类比尚无统一 universality classification；能谱、vortex size 和 defect statistics 对模型、friction、incompressibility/geometry敏感。
defect-centric reduction 可能在 nematic texture 滞后时失效；polarization 不是独立自由度，不能只推进点 defects 而忽略 background field。
frequency-dependent effective temperature T(ω) 可为负，且没有一般原则从它反演 microscopic mechanism；FDT violation 是活动信号，不是完整机理鉴定。
trajectory irreversibility 对 nearly any NESS 可用，但取决于 sampling interval 和 observed variables；它不能自动等于总能耗。
nonreciprocity、odd elasticity、non-Hermiticity 和 biological function 的桥梁多为结构类比或特定模型/实验，不能视为已建立的一一对应。
tissue continuum theory 的核心难点仍是把 coefficients 映射到 signaling 与 cell-scale mechanics；文章提出成功标准而非已完成映射。

sections.title: 复现与资源
bullets: 将本文作为 evidence map：每条卡片 claim 应记录原始 reference、体系尺度、wet/dry、theory/simulation/experiment 和作者标注的 open status。
defect analysis 至少保存 director field、charge winding、core positions/orientations、velocity、pair separation、creation/annihilation events，并检验 boundary/curvature。
irreversibility复现需固定 observable、sampling lag τ、trajectory length 与 time-reversal parity，报告 P(γτ)/P(γtildeτ) estimator bias 和 missing-variable sensitivity。
非互易模型要区分 coarse-grained effective violation 与封闭微观系统的 momentum conservation；显式记录 damping medium/field 如何吸收反作用。

sections.title: 阅读指南
bullets: 先读 Section I 的 operational definition：局域、持续 TRS breaking 是后文共同起点。
再按三条路径阅读：II–IV 的 flow/defect/control，V–VII 的 assembly/nonreciprocity/chirality，VIII–IX 的 thermodynamics/tissue。
最后阅读每节的问句与 Section X；这篇文章最有价值的是问题结构，不应被误包装成一组已经解决的普适定律。
